parsed.notes:
Only the qualifications section supplies candidate skill requirements; responsibilities and company descriptions are excluded.
Read literally, 'idealerweise' governs the coordinated remainder of its bullet, including KI-Governance and MCP; Python and SQL remain required.
AI Engineering is left unmapped rather than equated with ML Engineering or the broader AI/ML category.
Mapping 'Umsetzung produktiver KI-Lösungen' to AI deployment is flagged because implementation does not explicitly name deployment.
EU AI Act and DSGVO are regulatory domain knowledge, not separately labeled technical skills; KI-Governance is retained as an unmapped technical practice.
The two-year minimum is provisionally mapped to junior using the guide's 0–2-year range; the open-ended minimum makes this uncertain.
'B12' is preserved verbatim without correcting the apparent language-level typo.
'Vergleichbaren Fachrichtung' widens the degree field, not acceptance of experience instead of a degree.
